description: This file implements command-line interface logic for connecting to an OpenClaw gateway, parsing command-line options, handling connection setup, and outputting connection status or errors. It defines options parsing, connection logic, and output formatting for the 'connect' command in a macOS CLI tool.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: A struct representing command-line options for the connect command. It includes properties for URL, token, mode, timeout, and other connection parameters, along with a static method for parsing arguments.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: A struct that defines the output format of the connect command, including status, URL, role, scopes, snapshot, health information, and any error messages.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor that stores and retrieves snapshot data of type HelloOk, used asynchronously within the connection process.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into a ConnectOptions instance, handling flags and value options.
